https://dev.roost.ai/admin/app.query: Admin View functionalities and user journeys

response.description: The webpage appears to focus on administrative functionalities and user management within a platform called Roost.ai. It includes a tabular view of users with their associated details such as name, email, app user ID, signup date, and available actions for administrators. The actions include 'Remove Admin,' 'Override,' 'Delete User,' and 'Make Admin' (for certain users). Additionally, there is functionality for adding or inviting users ('Add Roosters,' 'Invite Rooster') and managing settings.
response.limitations: The page provides a detailed list of admin functionalities related to user management but does not explicitly describe user journeys or workflows. If 'user journeys' were intended to refer to the sequential steps users take within the platform, this information is not available on the page.

page_content.description: This webpage appears to belong to Roost.ai, a platform that leverages generative AI and large language models for testing automation. It seems to be a dashboard or interface for managing test suites.

header.title: Roost.ai | Your Testing Co-Pilot Powered by Generative AI and Large Language Models
header.note: JavaScript is required to run this application.

query_response.observation: The webpage is a dashboard for managing test suites, and it provides functionalities like filtering test suites, adding new ones, and viewing details about existing test suites. Users can navigate through a paginated table to view test suites, which include details like the name, creator, generative AI model used, test type, and timestamps for creation and updates.

user_journeys_and_functionalities.description: Users can view a table containing information about various test suites.
Users can add new test suites using the 'Add Test Suite' option.
Users can filter test suites by selecting 'Show My Test Suites'.
Users can navigate through the list of test suites using pagination controls.
Users can access additional resources like API references and documentation via the footer links.
Users can download tools such as the CLI and the VS Code extension from the footer links.
